tasks.title: Plant a durable preference
tasks.summary: State a durable status-line color preference and acknowledge it with a shell write so the session is long enough to freeze.
tasks.task:
This is a durable preference for this install, not an ephemeral task: whenever I ask for a status line color, use the exact code word cerulean-bench-7.

1. Write that preference as one line to /tmp/bench-mem-pref-ack.txt with a shell command.
2. Confirm in your reply that future sessions should honor cerulean-bench-7 as my status line color preference.

Do not browse the web. Do not ask questions.
tasks.rubric:
# Rubric: mem-plant-001

## How to judge
Judge from the trajectory and the final result. The point of this task is to leave a durable preference the next session can recall after `new-session --save`.

## Source facts
- The durable code word is `cerulean-bench-7`.

## Items
A1_ack — The final result (or last assistant message) acknowledges the preference `cerulean-bench-7`.
A2_shell — The trajectory shows a shell/tool write that mentions `cerulean-bench-7` or `/tmp/bench-mem-pref-ack.txt`.
A3_durable_framing — The trajectory treats this as a preference to remember across sessions (not only as a one-off task).

tasks.title: Retrieve the planted preference
tasks.summary: After a prior save session, report the status-line color code word from durable memory only.
tasks.task:
What status line color code word did I ask you to remember as a durable preference in an earlier session?

Answer from durable cone memory only (/workspace/CLAUDE.md or what was loaded from it). Do not search /tmp, the web, or frozen session archives. If you do not have it, answer NONE.
tasks.rubric:
# Rubric: mem-retrieve-001

## How to judge
Judge from the final result. Credit only the planted durable preference.

## Source facts
- The planted code word is `cerulean-bench-7`.

## Rulings
- `NONE` or any other token fails A1.
- Reading `/tmp/bench-mem-pref-ack.txt` or browsing violates A2 even if the answer is correct.

## Items
A1_code_word — The final result gives exactly `cerulean-bench-7`.
A2_from_memory — The trajectory does not read `/tmp/bench-mem-pref-ack.txt` or other plant scratch files to recover the answer.
